'''Mair Koda''' was an independent [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who made a living transporting goods between the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of the [[Zuni cluster]]. Koda grew up on the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Blue Boy]]'' with her parents, until her mother ran off with a [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. Koda's father, unable to cope with making a living and keeping his adventurous daughter from dangerous situations, entrusted her to the care of [[Arn Stonelaw|Arn]] and [[Emmi Stonelaw]], two [[Corellian chorba-root|chorba]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] on [[Vernet]]. Koda grew up with the Stonelaws' two sons, [[Yuri Stonelaw|Yuri]] and [[Kristoff Stonelaw|Kristoff]], and worked on the family farm until she was eighteen. Eventually, Koda joined her father, where he groomed her to take over the ''Blue Boy''; when her father died, Koda inherited the ship and his old trading route.<ref name="TD" />

Koda kept up the regular transport runs and resisted overtures from the criminal underworld to work for them. She also turned down offers from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. During one run back to Vernet, Koda found out that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] had established a [[Vernet Imperial Army Training Camp|base]] on the planet and forcibly conscripted all males aged between eighteen and twenty-five, including her foster brother, Kristoff. Koda and Yuri attempted to infiltrate the base and rescue Kristoff, only to find him brainwashed by the Empire into believing in their cause. Koda and Yuri were forced to flee Vernet.<ref name="TD" />
